rows.step1: A dark grey square button with a white microphone picture and the word Mute, on the far left of the bottom row of buttons.
instr: Click the dark button that says Mute at the bottom of the VideoChat window.

rows.step1: Dark grey rectangular button with a white camera picture and the words Stop video, second from the left in the bottom row.
instr: Click the dark button that says Stop video at the bottom of the call window.

rows.goal: make the text bigger in settings
rows.step1: A grey square icon with a white gear wheel, labelled Settings, third from the top on the left side.
instr: Click the Settings icon on the far left of your screen.
Click Display or Appearance in the Settings menu.
Choose a larger text size option or move the Text Size slider to the right.

rows.step1: A grey square with a white gear picture, labelled Settings, third down on the far left.
instr: Click the grey Settings picture on the left side of the screen.
Click the word Privacy inside the new Settings window.

rows.step1: Dark grey rectangular button labeled 'Share' with an upward arrow icon, in the bottom center row of buttons.
instr: Click the Share button at the bottom of the VideoChat window.
Click the option for your whole screen or the window you want to show, then confirm.

rows.step1: A dark grey square button with a white microphone picture and the word Mute, on the far left of the bottom row of buttons inside the VideoChat window.
instr: Click the dark button labeled Mute at the bottom of the VideoChat window.

rows.step1: Dark grey rectangular button with a white camera picture and the words Stop video, second from the left in the bottom row of buttons.
instr: Click the dark button that says Stop video at the bottom of the call window.

rows.goal: make the text bigger in settings
rows.step1: A grey square icon with a gear picture and the word Settings underneath, third down on the far left.
instr: Click the Settings icon on the left side of the screen.
Click on Display or Accessibility in the Settings menu.
Choose a larger text size option or move the text size slider to the right.

rows.step1: A grey square with a white gear picture and the word Settings underneath, third from the top on the left.
instr: Click the grey Settings picture on the left side of the screen.
Click the word Privacy inside the new Settings window.

rows.step1: Dark grey rectangular button labeled 'Share' with an upward arrow icon, in the bottom center row of buttons.
instr: Click the Share button at the bottom of the VideoChat window.
Choose the screen or window you want Lily to see, then click the confirm button.
